members.name: value
members.doc: The wheel's color, when the caller controls it. The wheel edits its hue and keeps the rest.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting color, when the wheel controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new color as a CSS string each time the hue changes. It is in the color space of the value, of the enclosing ColorPicker, or of defaultValue, and in hsla() form with none of them. A disabled or read-only wheel does not call it.

members.name: outerRadius
members.doc: The wheel's outer radius in pixels: the wheel is twice this wide and tall. It must be a finite number of 0 or more, and more than innerRadius.

members.name: innerRadius
members.doc: The radius of the hole in the middle, in pixels. It must be a finite number of 0 or more, and less than outerRadius.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the wheel: it can be neither focused nor changed. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the wheel read-only: it stays focusable but its hue cannot be changed. A read-only enclosing ColorPicker does the same.
